citizen_question: Medhavi scheme ke liye mera income certificate September 2025 ka hai, 14 mahine purana. Kya chalega ya naya banwana padega?
resolution: Naya banwana padega. Sabhi schemes ke liye income certificate issue date se 12 mahine tak hi valid hota hai (CIR-2026-002). 14 mahine purana certificate accept nahi hoga. Service centre pe naye income certificate ke liye turant apply kijiye. Medhavi ki last date 2026-11-21 (21 November 2026) hai, isliye der mat kijiye.
